title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Blades Brown's Historic Win
items.text: At 19, Blades Brown became the youngest PGA Tour leader in 95 years by winning the World Wide Technology Championship with a playoff birdie in Los Cabos after a 9-under 63 round.

items.headline: Ryann O'Toole's Million-Dollar LPGA Bonus
items.text: Ryann O'Toole secured the LPGA's $1 million Aon Risk Reward Challenge prize while on maternity leave, ending her 2026 season early due to pregnancy.

items.headline: Tiger Woods' New Golf Project
items.text: Tiger Woods launched a golf project that attracted two Cincinnati Bengals top receivers, marking a notable move off the field.
